test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.**

For Rahul, everything was a _________ (modern) experience until he stepped onto the field.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'new.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 modern
 relating to the present time; or something new. (वर्तमान समय से संबंधित; या कुछ नया)
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
• 
 
Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
• 
 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 new
 recently created or having started to exist recently. (हाल ही में बनाया गया है या हाल ही में अस्तित्व में आया है)
 
 

 flashy
 looking too bright, big, and expensive in a way that is intended to get attention and admiration. (एक तरह से बहुत उज्ज्वल, बड़ा और महंगा दिखना, जिसका उद्देश्य ध्यान और प्रशंसा प्राप्त करना है)
 
 

 global
 relating to the whole world. (पूरी दुनिया से संबंधित)
 
 

 asiatic
 relating to Asia. (एशिया से संबंधित)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Clearly, the word 'new' is closest in meaning to the given word 'modern.'
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 1.
